'MIK Innovation Hot Spot & MIK Night Party'
MIK INNOVATION HOTSPOT, which is a selection of Korean start-ups, is presented at CES 2019 EUREKAPARK (BOOTH # 52843).
MIK (MADE IN KOREA)is a project for AVING NEWS to publicize Korean companies for the past 3 years.The project started with a slogan, ‘MADE IN KOREA & MADE BY KOREA' and 500companies participated.

MIK INNOVATION HOTSPOT has been composed of the most innovative companies in Korea to compete inCES, the world's largest technology exhibition. At the event are large numbersof companies in the fields of AI, 5G, DRONS, ROBOTICS, AR, VR, BLOCKCHAIN,GAMING, MUSIC, DIGITAL HEALTH and SMART HOME.

Major participatingcompanies are BIG PICTURES, Awesome Bros Synergy, Changdae Tech, PROTOSTAR,Good Tec, Bug's Box, IP & PIMS, Deepscent Labs, HICODO, REALTRUE, SWANELECTRONICS, STAGE8, WOORIKIDS, Whoborn, iDiction, SmartreumBang-E, HeaventreePolaris3D, , SAFAUD, and EDENLUX.
The zone will grabmore attention due to the MIK STAGE, where major companies run exhibitions, MIKDAY PART, interview and pitching.
MIK DAY PARTY willbe held at the booth at 4:00 pm on January 9th and is an INVATION ONLY eventwhere invited media, investors and buyers participate.
For the global media, the most popular beverages and snacks in Korea are available free of charge during the exhibition period.

In addition, Korea’s representative start-up supporting institutions such as Daejeon Information & Culture Industry Promotion Agency, Kyungpook National University Smart Venture Campus, INCHEON BUSINESS INFORMATION TECHNOPARK, Changwon Industry Promotion Agency and Korea Invention Promotion Association participated as supporting partners.

In addition, MIKNIGHT, which is held on the evening of November 10, the 3rd day of theexhibition, invites investors, buyers and media to business networking partiesconducted by Korean companies participating in CES 2019.
Product demos,events and Global Media's BEST OF MIK award winners are also announced.
MIK NIGHT is anINVATION ONLY event where invited media, investors, and buyers participate in aseparate venue from 6:00 pm to 9:00 pm on January 10th.
Investors, buyersand media who want to participate in MIK DAY PARTY and MIK NIGHT PART can applyat registration desk or e-mail (ces@aving.net).

Meanwhile, 'AVINGNEWS', which has been active as a media partner (MWC, IFA) annually and hasestablished major news organizations and global news networks in 54 countries,along with a global and domestic MICE specialist company, Global Mega ExpertGroup Co., Ltd (GMEG – CEO Lee Hae-jung) will continue to build aninfrastructure to publicize Korean companies worldwide.
